claim: The one-click demo starts with four sample artifacts and never changes the real portfolio.
sandbox: fresh browser; sentinel real state; mutate and reset demo; assert real bytes unchanged and demo key removed on exit

claim: The challenge deck and local portfolio work offline after one visit.
sandbox: fresh demo context; install service worker; disable network; reload and assert sample portfolio

claim: Normal free and demo use sends no data away and requires no account.
where: first-screen facts, privacy section, privacy page, README
sandbox: fresh demo context; intercept every request through filter, open, and reset flows; assert same-origin only

claim: No purchase action or price is shown while the hosted checkout is unavailable.
where: landing page, privacy page, terms, README
sandbox: fresh demo context; leave for the real workspace and assert no checkout, purchase, price, or buy action

claim: The free deck has eight challenges across six skill modes, each with a four-row adult or peer rubric.
where: first screen, included strip, challenge deck, README
sandbox: fresh demo context; count cards, mode filters, and rendered rubric rows

claim: A family can print the selected challenge or every challenge in its print deck.
where: first-screen print action, challenge actions, README
sandbox: fresh real and demo workspaces; stub browser print dialog and assert exact printable sheet counts

claim: A family can export its portfolio as JSON.
sandbox: fresh demo context; download JSON and assert format plus all four sample artifacts

claim: A family can export a challenge deck as JSON with CC BY 4.0 reuse licenses.
sandbox: fresh demo context; download selected deck and assert format, count, and every license

claim: Challenge deck imports require and preserve the CC BY 4.0 reuse license.
sandbox: fresh demo context; reject a license-less fixture, then import the equivalent licensed fixture

claim: Demo, privacy, terms, and missing pages have real routes, accurate titles, and route focus.
sandbox: fresh demo context; click, back, and direct-load routes; assert title, canonical, focus, and 404 content

claim: A family can make a challenge locally without changing real data during a demo.
sandbox: fresh demo context; create a licensed challenge and compare real and demo storage namespaces

claim: The product is a static TypeScript site with local assets and initial JS and CSS within factory budgets.
sandbox: production dist from clean build; measure emitted JS/CSS, inspect external scripts/styles, and run axe
